sections.heading: Inputs
sections.text: Use current revision C, a 30 mm initial primary seat, and the signed convention: positive means downward travel. Relative withdrawal equals yoke travel minus carrier travel. Bounded errors are combined by interval arithmetic, not by assuming independence.

sections.heading: Seated check
sections.text: At the centered, seated post-event inspection position the keeper overlap is 8 +/- 1 mm. Under the rigid centered seated geometry, simple vertical passage over the yoke is not possible. This test does not reproduce the incident offset or rotation.

sections.heading: Open calculation
sections.text: The incident lateral offset and release rotation are not measured. An approved off-center dynamic retention envelope is unavailable. Primary seating loss can be assessed from supplied vertical data; keeper bypass cannot be resolved from that calculation alone.

sections.heading: Required follow-up
sections.text: Obtain a time-relevant lateral/rotation measurement or a validated retention-envelope analysis with an independently bounded incident offset. Repeating the centered seated measurement without new scope does not answer the dynamic question.
